items.title: HIG Q3 Earnings Beat on Investment Income and Premium Growth
items.summary: The Hartford Insurance Group (HIG) reported Q3 2026 core EPS of $3.50, beating estimates by 11.1%, with revenues rising 5.3% to $5.4 billion. Net investment income climbed 12.6% year-over-year, and the company returned $638 million to shareholders while raising its quarterly dividend 12% to 67 cents per share. However, higher catastrophe losses and weaker Employee Benefits profitability partially offset gains.
